subject: Aligning MAP milestones, exit gates & acceptance tests — timeline and owners
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Eliot Harper <eliot.harper@mednova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP & proposed exit gates — quick alignment

Hi Eliot —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I pulled together a first-pass MAP and a compact set of acceptance tests so we can scope the evaluation run and the close timeline. Attached: MedNova_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones, owners, and success criteria) and a short acceptance-tests-harness spec.

Key asks from our side to keep the timeline tight:
- Confirm the three success dimensions below (accuracy, throughput/latency, integration completeness) — are these aligned with your stakeholders?
- Identify a single sign-off owner for each exit gate (tech, security, and procurement).
- Any mandatory evidence for SOC2 / audit you need included in the MAP?

Proposed high-level exit gates (week-based):
1) Alpha validation (week 1–2): smoke tests, 70% accuracy on sample canonical prompts, basic infra connectivity. Owner: Ben.
2) Performance stage (week 3–4): 95th percentile latency < 400ms on 8k token mix, batching plan validated. Owner: Alex.
3) Security/compliance sign-off (week 4): SOC2 evidence snapshot + access control review. Owner: Marissa.
4) Handoff & go/no-go (week 5): end-to-end demo, runbook and rollback plan, contract countersign. Owner: Monica (CS).

I pushed the acceptance criteria into column C of the spreadsheet; the harness spec lists concrete tests we can automate. If this looks good I can update the MAP with specific dates and push to the shared drive.

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

Attachments: MedNova_MAP_v1.xlsx, acceptance-tests-harness-spec.md
From: Eliot Harper <eliot.harper@mednova.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: MedNova Procurement <procurement@mednova.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & proposed exit gates — quick alignment

Alex —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear gates. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we lock dates:

1) For the accuracy target: does the 70% for Alpha refer to raw generation pass-rate on our internal test set, or to a weighted F1 on labeled items? Wed like to map to our internal metric (label-match %) so procurement can understand risk.

2) Security evidence: we will need a statement on data residency during the evaluation (specifically: model inputs are retained for 30 days in staging only). Can you confirm that retention window and where logs are stored? Also, is there an exportable audit log for token-level request ids?

3) Procurement wants to see a short list of acceptance artifacts they can attach to the contract as milestones (e.g., signed go/no-go note, performance report PDF, and runbook acceptance). Can you add a short artifacts list to the MAP?

Looping in procurement so they can flag anything else. If you can reply with a version that maps your acceptance tests to our label-match metric and the artifacts list, well circulate internally.

Thanks,
Eliot Harper
Head of ML Ops — MedNova Health
eliot.harper@mednova.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Eliot Harper <eliot.harper@mednova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & proposed exit gates — quick alignment

Eliot — thanks, great questions. See answers inline below and I attached a revised MAP (MedNova_MAP_v1.xlsx -> MedNova_MAP_v1b.xlsx) with a short artifacts checklist.

1) Accuracy mapping: the Alpha 70% number was a pass-rate shorthand. Weve replaced that in the spreadsheet with your preferred label-match % and included a column that maps each acceptance test to the corresponding label-match threshold (column D). Example: canonical prompt set A -> label-match >= 68% to pass alpha.

2) Data residency / retention: for the evaluation we retain inputs and request-level metadata in staging for a default of 30 days (configurable). Audit logs with request ids and UUIDs for token events are exportable as a gzipped JSON stream. I added a short export spec in the acceptance-tests-harness-spec.md attachment. Security owner Marissa — can you confirm the export controls and add a note if we need a longer retention window for procurement?

3) Acceptance artifacts: added to the MAP under the 'Artifacts for Contract' tab. Short list we propose:
- Signed Go/No-Go email (owner: MedNova signatory)
- Performance Report PDF with raw metrics and SLA table (owner: Redwood)
- Runbook + rollback checklist acceptance (owner: MedNova ops)
- Evidence bundle for SOC2 items used in evaluation (owner: Redwood security)

Proposed updated timeline (dates are placeholders until we get your preferred start):
- Week 0 (prep): dataset handoff + access, sprint plan
- Week 1: alpha validation (label-match run, smoke)
- Week 2: performance tuning & throughput testing
- Week 3: security evidence bundle & procurement artifact review
- Week 4: go/no-go window and contract countersign

Monica, can your team own the final runbook deliverable and the cutover checklist? Ben will lead the alpha test runs and provide the performance report. Marissa can you confirm the security export note above?

If MedNova confirms the start week we can attach firm dates and book weekly checkpoints (Wed 10am PT suggested).

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: MedNova_MAP_v1b.xlsx, acceptance-tests-harness-spec.md, SLA_draft_redlines.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & proposed exit gates — quick alignment

Alex / team 

Quick note 
- Confirmed: audit export includes token-level request ids and can be scoped per-environment (staging only for evaluation) with default 30-day retention. I added a short security checklist row in the MAP (column F) calling out encryption-at-rest, KMS key ID, and export format.
- Monica: Ive assigned the runbook deliverable to you in the sheet (Runbook v0.1 due at the start of Week 4).
- Ben: I scheduled a 90-minute alpha test slot for Tue Week 1 to run the canonical prompt set and capture label-match results.

Eliot — from a security gating perspective the artifacts list Alex added should work for procurement; if you need a scoped addendum listing exact logs or PII redaction steps we can append that to the artifact bundle.

Ill update the shared MAP with firm dates once MedNova confirms a start week. Thanks everyone.

—Marissa
VP, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
